_comment: Researched boarding-school data (read 25 Oct 2026 unless noted). Every boarding fact is from the page in its boarding_source_url; school identity, address, PIN and foundation year of CBSE schools come from their CBSE SARAS affiliation record. boarding_type is left blank when the source says 'boarding' or 'residential' without saying whether every student boards. Not a ranking. 'cbse' entries are applied by build-saras-csv.js to the SARAS record with that affiliation number; 'systems' rules apply to every school of that network; 'schools' are complete rows for the admin JSON import (schools not affiliated to CBSE).

JAWAHAR_NAVODAYA_VIDYALAYA.entry_classes: VI (JNVST); lateral entry to IX and XI as notified
JAWAHAR_NAVODAYA_VIDYALAYA.boarding_summary: Co-educational Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya run by the Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti. Education, board and lodging, uniform and textbooks are free; boys and girls live in separate hostels. Admission to Class VI is through the district-level JNVST.

530035.name: Sainik School Kunjpura
530035.boarding_summary: Sainik School of the Sainik Schools Society, Ministry of Defence. Cadets live in 20 dormitories grouped into 10 houses; admission to Classes VI and IX is through AISSEE.

3530014.name: Sainik School Ghorakhal
3530014.boarding_summary: Sainik School near Nainital, founded in 1966. The school provides hostel and mess facilities for cadets; admission to Classes VI and IX is through AISSEE.
3530014.accommodation: Hostel and mess facilities for cadets (school website).

3480001.name: Sainik School Tilaiya
3480001.boarding_summary: Describes itself as a CBSE-affiliated residential school; boys and girl cadets. Admission to Classes VI and IX is through AISSEE.

1780002.name: Rashtriya Military School Ajmer
1780002.entry_classes: VI (age 10–12) and IX (age 13–15) as on 31 March
1780002.boarding_summary: Ministry of Defence military school. All admissions are as boarders (no day scholars) and exclusively for boys, through the Common Entrance Test held in December and an interview.

1780003.boarding_summary: Ministry of Defence military school. All RMS admissions are as boarders (no day scholars) and exclusively for boys, through the Common Entrance Test held in December and an interview.

680005.entry_classes: VI (age 10–12) and IX (age 13–15) as on 31 March
680005.boarding_summary: Ministry of Defence military school in the Shimla hills. All RMS admissions are as boarders (no day scholars) and exclusively for boys, through the Common Entrance Test held in December and an interview.

1730001.name: Mayo College
1730001.entry_classes: IV–IX and XI (XI after Class X results, limited seats)
1730001.boarding_summary: All-boys residential school in Ajmer, established in 1875; CBSE and Cambridge curricula. Admission is by an offline Aptitude Analysis in English and Mathematics, held each October.

1030003.name: The Scindia School
1030003.boarding_summary: Boys' boarding school on Gwalior Fort with houses, housemasters and resident tutors. Admission is through the Common Aptitude Assessment (November) or the School Aptitude Assessment (late January/early February) in English, Mathematics and Hindi.

1730008.name: Birla Public School, Pilani
1730008.boarding_summary: Fully residential boys-only school (Vidya Niketan Birla Public School), started by G. D. Birla in 1944. Admission usually involves an entrance test, a review of academic performance and an interaction.

1730010.name: Birla Balika Vidyapeeth
1730010.boarding_summary: English-medium residential public school for girls in Pilani. Applicants for Classes V–IX take a 30-minute aptitude assessment in Hindi, English, Mathematics and Mental Ability, followed by an interaction with parents.

630013.name: The Lawrence School, Sanawar
630013.entry_classes: V, VI and VII (session 2027-28); largest intake in V and VI
630013.boarding_summary: Co-educational boarding school established in 1847; boys and girls are housed in separate departments. Admission is through an offline Common Entrance Test in English, Mathematics, Science and Hindi.
630013.accommodation: Boys and girls are housed in separate departments (school website).

1930001.name: The Lawrence School, Lovedale
1930001.entry_classes: V–IX and XI (recommended age for Class V: 10+)
1930001.boarding_summary: CBSE school near Ooty, established in 1858, with Prep (Classes IV–VI), Junior (VII–VIII) and Senior (IX–XII) schools, each with its own classrooms and dormitories; girls are housed in the girls' school.
1930001.accommodation: Classrooms and dormitories of the Prep, Junior and Senior schools are in their own buildings; girls are housed in the girls' school (school website).

3530238.name: Welham Boys' School
3530238.boarding_summary: Boys' boarding school in Dehradun founded in 1937, affiliated to CBSE. Entry to Grades IV–IX is through the Proficiency & Aptitude Assessment (next: 15 November 2026).

3420006._note: Checked 2026-10-30 against netarhatvidyalaya.com and advertisement no. 262 (13.08.2026). CBSE SARAS gives the managing body as 'indian trust singape', which contradicts the school's own notices; the advertisement names Netarhat Vidyalaya Samiti. CBSE leaves the PIN field empty; the postal address and the school's contact page give 835218.
3420006.managing_body: Netarhat Vidyalaya Samiti (School Education and Literacy Department, Government of Jharkhand)
3420006.boarding_summary: Jharkhand government residential school for boys, founded in 1954 in the gurukul tradition and run by the Netarhat Vidyalaya Samiti. Entry is to Class 6 only, through a two-level written test and then physical and psychological tests. The admission notice describes the education as free; the school's fee page says guardians pay a subsidised fee by income group (A–E).
3420006.accommodation: Boys live in hostels called ashrams: 21 ashrams in seven sets of three houses, each set with a central kitchen. Each house has about 20 to 30 boys in the care of a house master and a house mother.
3420006.dining: Each set of ashrams has a centrally located kitchen; the school says it provides a sumptuous and nutritious diet.
3420006.medical_care: A 15-bed sick room in the Chalet, staffed by a medical officer, a compounder, a sister, a dresser and two attendants. Medicines prescribed by the doctor are free; emergencies are referred to RMCH (as named by the school).

schools.name: Rashtriya Indian Military College
schools.description: Inter-service military college preparing cadets for the Defence Forces. Admission is only at Class VIII, for boys and girls; separate merit lists are published for each.
schools.entry_classes: VIII only (candidates in or past Class VII)
schools.boarding_summary: Military college admitting cadets to Class VIII only. The published fee structure is for boarder cadets, including hostel maintenance and washerman, barber and clothing charges.

schools.name: Welham Girls' School
schools.description: Girls' school in Dehradun with Classes VI to XII, affiliated to the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations.
schools.boarding_summary: Girls' school in Dehradun, Classes VI–XII, showing Boarding Schools' Association of India accreditation and describing its houses, meals, outings and holidays. Admission is by an aptitude/proficiency assessment.

schools.name: Woodstock School
schools.description: International Baccalaureate World School in Mussoorie offering a US Diploma and IB Diploma pathway.
schools.boarding_summary: Describes itself as Asia's oldest international boarding school (since 1854), for students in Grades 6 to 12; IB World School with a US Diploma and IB Diploma pathway. Applications for 2027/28 are made online.

schools.name: Sherwood College
schools.description: Co-educational residential school in Nainital (Classes III–XII), established in 1869 and affiliated to CISCE.
schools.boarding_summary: Co-educational residential institution for Classes III–XII in Nainital, established in 1869 and affiliated to CISCE.
